title: senecio sericeus var. gilliesii
intro: Senecio sericeus var. gilliesii, commonly known as Woolly Groundsel, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents present in Woolly Groundsel include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Senecio sericeus var. gilliesii.
